# Riseklix

> Riseklix is a research firm for service businesses. We record how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews answer the questions buyers ask before they hire a firm, trace which sources each answer relied on, and show what to fix. We also run market research and idea validation.

Canonical site: https://riseklix.com/
Contact: contact@riseklix.com
Founder: Satwik Kumar
Based in: New Delhi, India. Works with firms in the UK, US, Europe and Australia.
Founded: 2024

## Services and prices

- AI Discovery Study: 10 buyer situations x 4 questions x 5 AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), about 200 recorded answers. Delivers shortlists, source trails, competitor pages and ranked fixes. From US$250, paid upfront.
- Monthly tracking: the agreed questions tracked three times a month, with two runs per AI tool. US$400 to US$600 a month.
- Implementation: closing the evidence gaps a study finds, on the firm's website and beyond it: articles, LinkedIn and Reddit content, video, directories, reviews and press. Quoted per scope, after a study.
- Market research and idea validation: demand, market sizing, history, competitor teardowns and pricing, ending in a go, pivot or not-yet verdict. Quoted per scope.
- Research partnership: flagship reports, monthly market and competitor briefs, resources and models. Quoted per scope, monthly.
- Partners: research behind agency and consultant advice, delivered under the partner's name.

## What Riseklix does not promise

- A ranking. AI answers don't have one.
- Guaranteed placement in any AI tool.
- That money buys recommendations.

## Research articles

- [Why AI Recommends Your Competitors: 5 Patterns](https://riseklix.com/resources/why-ai-recommends-your-competitors/): We record AI answers to real buyer questions. Here are the five patterns that decide who gets recommended, and what to change on your side.
- [Google AI Overviews: How to Check If Your Firm Is Cited](https://riseklix.com/resources/google-ai-overviews-for-service-firms/): A simple way to check whether Google AI Overviews mention or link your firm, what to record each time, and what tends to get a service firm included.
- [Businesses in ChatGPT: What the Dashboard Shows, Misses](https://riseklix.com/resources/businesses-in-chatgpt-explained/): OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT lets you claim a profile and see mentions. Here is what the dashboard counts, what it can't see, and what to do next.
- [How to Validate a Business Idea: 6 Questions to Answer](https://riseklix.com/resources/how-to-validate-a-business-idea/): Before you build, answer six questions with evidence: demand, market size, history, competitors, pricing and the verdict. A practical checklist.
- [Competitor Analysis: See How Rivals Actually Execute](https://riseklix.com/resources/competitor-analysis-how-competitors-execute/): A competitor analysis that goes past feature lists: positioning, pricing pages, channels, hiring, reviews and what AI says. With a teardown template.
- [Pricing Research: How to Find What Buyers Will Pay](https://riseklix.com/resources/pricing-research-what-buyers-will-pay/): A practical way to set a first price: collect public price points, build a price band, study packaging, then test with buyers before you commit.
- [AI Visibility for Recruitment Firms: What a Study Found](https://riseklix.com/resources/ai-visibility-for-recruitment-firms/): We recorded 352 AI answers for one recruitment firm. It was recommended 27 of 32 times for one hire and 4 of 32 for another. Here is why.
- [AI Visibility for Commercial Contractors: What We Found](https://riseklix.com/resources/ai-visibility-for-commercial-contractors/): We asked five AI tools what developers and property managers ask about commercial roofing and siding. 50 answers showed who gets shortlisted, and why.
